## SAN JUAN RIVER BASIN.

In the area drained by the San Juan, comprising approximately 25,800 square miles, irrigation has been practiced for more than 40 years, and on many of the tributaries the low-water flow is not suffi- cient to meet present needs. Only a small quantity of stored water is, however, being utilized. The area irrigated in the San Juan basin in 1913, consisting largely of bottom lands, is shown by the follow- ing table:
